title: Outline prepass consumes needsUpdate shadow token — bomber and bomb shadows disappear after first movement
summary: S177 landed the outline-occluder prepass system (S278/S279). The prepass calls `adapter.renderSceneToTarget()` — which calls `device.render(scene, camera)` — BEFORE the main render. When the dynamic-shadow-system (S52) has set `shadowMap.autoUpdate=false` and queued `shadowMap.needsUpdate=true` (happens after the first bomber/bomb movement), the prepass `device.render()` consumes the `needsUpdate` token while source bombers and bombs are HIDDEN (toggled `visible=false` by outline-prepass-system). Three.js bakes the shadow map without any moving casters, clears `needsUpdate`. The subsequent main render sees `needsUpdate=false` and skips the shadow update entirely, leaving the shadow map empty of character/bomb shadows. Visually: the floor is uniformly lit, no shadows under bombers or bombs after the first movement.
repro: Let any bomber (bot or player) take one step — dynamic-shadow-system detects the first LTW delta, flips `autoUpdate=false`, queues `needsUpdate=true`.
Observe the floor: shadows under bombers and bombs are absent. The floor is uniformly lit regardless of bomber position.
Cross-check: load with `?occluderOutline=off` — shadows are correct, confirming the regression is in the prepass render consuming the needsUpdate token.
expected: Ground shadows visible under all bombers and placed bombs throughout a round, matching the S180 shadow baseline (light.sun castShadow=true, bias=0, normalBias=0.285, 2048 shadow map).
actual: Floor uniformly lit after the first frame any bomber moves. No shadow drop visible under bombers or bombs for the rest of the round. Confirmed via Playwright screenshot (qa-artifacts/shadow-check-2026-06-04.png) and snapshot probe: shadowCasters=1 light with castShadow=true, 43 ShadowCaster{dynamic:true} entities, floor shows no shadows.
